## Final report (Phase 2 complete — landed & closed)

**Problem.** Floor `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` leg emitted teardown ERRORs `New entries appeared in REPO_ROOT during this test: ['.pytest_cache']` (`tests/conftest.py:379`).

**Proven root cause.** The `_no_repo_root_leaks` autouse guard (`tests/conftest.py`) diffs REPO_ROOT top-level entries around each test and `pytest.fail`s on any new one, exempting only coverage.py files via `_is_coverage_artifact`. `.pytest_cache/` (gitignored `.gitignore:7`; written by the pytest framework, not a test body) was never exempted → the guard trips when the floor-leg pytest writes it under REPO_ROOT despite `-p no:cacheprovider`. Same class as the coverage carve-out.

**Proof (RED evidence).** Drove the REAL guard teardown against a scratch REPO_ROOT: with only `.pytest_cache/` appearing it FAILED (returned the leak message) — RED for the right reason (missing exemption, not pytest writing the dir). Mixed case (`.pytest_cache` + real `stray_report.json`) failed naming BOTH, proving the guard couldn't distinguish. Held-out oracle: `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py::test_leak_guard_exempts_pytest_cache`.

**Defect origin (`caused_by` recorded).** Omission / scope-of-work → task **8d36** (`8d36-a15a-fcbd-4ebd`, commit `f943c7ef5884`), which introduced the "framework/gitignored artifact is not a leak" carve-out but enumerated only coverage. Close-class `preexisting`; change 2420 (`47713c44`) only EXPOSED the latent omission by unblocking the floor unit tier. `caused_by` edge verified on the closed ticket.

**Fix.** New `_is_framework_artifact` predicate over `_TOOLING_CACHE_ARTIFACTS` = {`.pytest_cache`,`.ruff_cache`,`.mypy_cache`,`.mutmut-cache`,`__pycache__`} at the guard's filter callsite. Restoration (extends an existing exemption), no new dependency, no test weakened. Portable: static name allowlist, no pytest-version/CI-provider trigger.

**Teeth (mutation check, sandboxed).** Removing `.pytest_cache` → both `.pytest_cache` tests RED. Removing `.ruff_cache` → the pinned-contract class test `test_leak_guard_exempts_every_tooling_cache_artifact` RED (first draft was a tautology reading the impl set; rewritten to a fixed contract list so it truly bites). GREEN restored after.

**Still catches pollution.** `test_leak_guard_still_fails_on_real_pollution_beside_pytest_cache`: a genuine entry beside `.pytest_cache` still fails and is named; `.pytest_cache` is not.

**Sibling sweep.** Axis-2 parity: the only other REPO_ROOT surface, the session working-tree backstop (`pytest_sessionfinish` porcelain diff), uses `git status --porcelain` which already EXCLUDES gitignored paths → `.pytest_cache` never appears there (immune, N/A). HEAD-move guard is about commits (N/A). No other raw-filesystem-entry guard exists → no un-fixed siblings.

**Verification.** `make lint` ✓, `make typecheck` ✓ (705 files), full `make test` = 18190 passed; the 8 failing `tests/interfaces/` git-remote tests are PRE-EXISTING (reproduced identically on pristine origin/main with my changes stashed) and unrelated — my change only relaxes the leak guard, it cannot cause a new failure.

**Landed.** Gerrit change **2427** — `LLM-Review+1` (PASS) AND `Verified+1` (CI green: ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS py3.13, mutation/optionality/packaging gates) — **MERGED** to main. Ticket closed `preexisting`.

**Replication.** Original report no longer reproduces: the guard passes when `.pytest_cache` appears under REPO_ROOT (exercised end-to-end via the REAL fixture teardown).
